items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So some years later I met Mr. Bill Bailey, and he had come along with a different way of doing a Bubbles tap step

ctx.x: Would you show us again, Chuck?

Well, now, here's another for instance of Bubbles. He taught me a step like this. (Tap dancing.) See? He taught me that. He called that the Studio Tap. So now, as I said, I'd get away to myself and try to teach myself another way of doing the same step that he had taught me. So I would come back, and I came back with this here. (Tap dancing.) (Inaudible). See, I didn't want to get caught, see. He inspired me, like if someone else would attempt to teach me something, like some years later I ran into Mr. Bill…
